544:t_2:257.en:
$$宗介$$
「What is this 'original world'? If you start there, every world since the $$大時空震動$$ would have to be wrong.」

544:t_2:258.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Then suppose this world is a mistake. What do you think should be done with it?」

544:t_2:259.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nothing needs to be done. Leave it alone. Remaking a world is something only a god could...」

544:t_2:261.en:
$$レナード$$
「Exactly. If you become a god, you can set this world right.」

544:t_2:262.en:
$$レナード$$
「Restore this distorted world to its original history.」

544:t_2:264.en:
$$宗介$$
「Returning to the original history you speak of means denying all of us who live in the present one, doesn't it? I can't stand that.」

544:t_2:265.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then what? Should we gather the will of everyone in the world, like when you broke the $$時の牢獄$$?」

544:t_2:267.en:
$$レナード$$
「That is absurd. It's pointless to ask for the consent of people one by one when they don't know what this world means.」

544:t_2:268.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then are you saying you'll remake the world with your will alone?」

544:t_2:269.en:
$$レナード$$
「Let me ask you something in return. If $$千鳥かなめ$$ died, what would you do?」

544:t_2:271.en:
$$レナード$$
「If that were the result of a distorted world, wouldn't you think of remaking it?」

544:t_2:273.en:
$$レナード$$
「You can't answer... Of course not.」

544:t_2:274.en:
$$レナード$$
「If I were in your position, I probably couldn't accept it either. The world of emotion is one where rules and unwritten laws, all those formalities, don't apply.」

544:t_2:275.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't you people tend to see things far too simply?」

544:t_2:276.en:
$$レナード$$
「Good and evil, likes and dislikes, friend and foe... You don't believe in that kind of dualism either, do you?」

544:t_2:277.en:
$$宗介$$
「What are you trying to say?」

544:t_2:278.en:
$$レナード$$
「Who knows. I just thought that maybe we don't really need to fight.」

544:t_2:280.en:
$$レナード$$
「I didn't bring up peace talks. And whatever I explained, the answer would be no anyway, wouldn't it?」

544:t_2:281.en:
$$レナード$$
「I've known that all along. That's why I never bothered with any conciliation efforts.」

544:t_2:283.en:
$$レナード$$
「Your stubbornness is a handful. ...But Mr. $$カリーニン$$ was different.」

544:t_2:286.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's no way the Major would switch sides over your delusions.」

544:t_2:287.en:
$$レナード$$
「What do you know about him?」

544:t_2:289.en:
$$レナード$$
「He felt the distortion in this world... You could even say he hated it.」

544:t_2:290.en:
$$レナード$$
「To show him the power to set it right, I demonstrated that weapon at $$第２新東京市$$.」

544:t_2:292.en:
$$レナード$$
「Right. It means more than just being used as a weapon.」

544:t_2:293.en:
$$レナード$$
「And he was convinced. That there is a means of correcting the mistake, and that I hold that power.」

544:t_2:294.en:
$$レナード$$
「To be precise, it isn't $$アマルガム$$ he sided with. It's me.」

544:t_2:296.en:
$$宗介$$
(But the Major did... bring up the existence of the AS and talk about how unnatural this world is...)

544:t_2:297.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll have you know that $$テレサ$$ has a vague idea of my goal.」

544:t_2:298.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even so, she's trying to obstruct it without explaining anything to you. Do you know why?」

544:t_2:299.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Are you saying that some in $$ミスリル$$... no, in $c, too, would come to agree with you?」

544:t_2:300.en:
$$レナード$$
「Exactly. That's why $$テレサ$$ doesn't explain everything.」

544:t_2:301.en:
$$レナード$$
「She believes we should accept the past and keep going with history as it is. Positive and admirable, and a perfect line of reasoning for self-intoxication.」

544:t_2:302.en:
$$レナード$$
「There's surely revenge against $$アマルガム$$ in it. And surely resistance to controlling the world.」

544:t_2:303.en:
$$レナード$$
「But the girl's strongest motive is defiance of me. She believes the only way to prove her own strength is to deny what I do.」

544:t_2:304.en:
$$宗介$$
「She is not that selfish a person.」

544:t_2:305.en:
$$レナード$$
「That sibling quarrel will be over soon enough.」

544:t_2:307.en:
$$レナード$$
「The construction of the new $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ has entered its final stage.」

544:t_2:308.en:
$$レナード$$
「A facility on a scale that makes every previous $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ look like nothing.」

544:t_2:309.en:
$$レナード$$
「By combining that power with the $$時空震動弾$$, we will interfere with the past.」

544:t_2:310.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that is your final plan.」

544:t_2:311.en:
$$レナード$$
「An ordinary $$ウィスパード$$ won't do as the catalyst. We need the one person, probably the only suitable one, who was imprinted with the greatest power.」

544:t_2:312.en:
$$レナード$$
「The one who received the most data from the psychic waves... the Tau waves from the accident here. In other words, the $$特異点$$ of the $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ runaway...」

544:t_2:315.en:
$$レナード$$
「The one who sent the technical information from the future to the $$ウィスパード$$s was not some unidentified someone.」

544:t_2:316.en:
$$レナード$$
「It was her. She is the one who is going to do it.」

544:t_2:318.en:
$$レナード$$
「She is abnormally lucky because she is a living $$特異点$$.」

544:t_2:319.en:
$$レナード$$
「So to speak, she is not a $$ウィスパード$$, one who is whispered to, but a $$ウィスパリング$$, one who whispers...」

544:t_2:320.en:
$$レナード$$
「She is the one who sent the Black Technology that ruined this world into the past.」

544:t_2:321.en:
$$宗介$$
「...She is a decent person. Whatever the reasoning, she would never gladly send technology that distorts the world to anyone.」

544:t_2:322.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't quite follow the sequence of events, but in any case, she wouldn't do such a thing.」

544:t_2:323.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's exactly what puzzles me.」

544:t_2:324.en:
$$レナード$$
「Why would a girl that strong and that righteous interfere with the past?」

544:t_2:325.en:
$$レナード$$
「What exactly is this past that she can't accept?」

544:t_2:326.en:
$$レナード$$
「Did it happen long ago? Or is it something that is yet to happen?」

544:t_2:327.en:
$$レナード$$
「And who examined the information she holds in the first place? Is there another $$ウィスパリング$$ even further in the future?」

544:t_2:330.en:
$$宗介$$
「All I know is that I will not hand $$千鳥$$ over to a man like you.」

544:t_2:331.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even if you get her back, you can't return to your old life.」

544:t_2:334.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even if I cast her aside, someone else will go after her sooner or later... the Empire, say.」

544:t_2:335.en:
$$レナード$$
「With that ability, there is no safe haven for her anywhere in this distorted world.」
